overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly specialized, academic-focused social media presence with 3,580 total followers across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon. His posts focus heavily on computational social science, disinformation studies, and coordinated online behavior. Across all platforms, he enjoys robust audience interaction, particularly when sharing milestone achievements such as peer-reviewed publications, major research grants, and academic hiring opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, software tool releases (like CooRnet v2.0), and conference presentations focusing on computational methods for analyzing coordinated online activities.
Announcements regarding research grants, postdoctoral hiring, and research opportunities for PhD students.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's exceptionally high engagement rate by prioritizing it for early discussions of research findings and interactive scholarly Q&As.
Diversify hiring efforts by cross-posting academic openings (such as the postdoc positions) to Bluesky and Mastodon, leveraging their highly active academic communities.
Increase engagement on Mastodon by publishing more platform-specific technical threads detailing the algorithms behind tools like CooRnet.
Incorporate visual media, such as paper abstract figures or tool screenshots, to LinkedIn posts to further increase click-through and interaction rates on major professional announcements.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky yields the highest relative engagement rate (6.14% average), driven strongly by community shares (reposts) on academic papers and student opportunities, pointing to a highly receptive academic audience.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a highly focused but smaller niche audience. Technical tool updates perform well here, but overall growth requires active community engagement and consistent posting.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn serves as the primary professional hub, driving the highest absolute volume of interactions (likes and comments) particularly around career opportunities, team expansion, and institutional milestones.
